id: a1f3c7e2-5b9d-4e21-9c84-7f2e1d6a8b03
status: experimental
description: Detects a forward-proxy request to the NetLicensing REST API whose URL combines the /product/ segment with a traversal/token sequence, the wire artefact of the netlicensing-mcp path-traversal token-redaction bypass (GHSA-hxpf-9xvq-wph8).
references:
  - https://github.com/advisories/GHSA-hxpf-9xvq-wph8
author: SOC Detection Engineering
date: 2026/06/20
tags:
  - attack.t1190
  - attack.initial_access
logsource:
  category: proxy
detection:
  selection_host:
    cs-host|contains:
      - 'go.netlicensing.io'
      - 'netlicensing.labs64.com'
  selection_product:
    c-uri|contains: '/product/'
  selection_traversal:
    c-uri|contains:
      - '/token'
      - '/../'
      - '%2e%2e'
      - '%2f'
      - '%5c'
  condition: selection_host and selection_product and selection_traversal
falsepositives:
  - Authorized vulnerability scanning of the NetLicensing integration
level: high
3063.spl:
| tstats `summariesonly` count min(_time) as firstTime max(_time) as lastTime from datamodel=Web where Web.dest IN ("go.netlicensing.io","netlicensing.labs64.com") AND Web.url="*/product/*" AND (Web.url="*token*" OR Web.url="*%2e%2e*" OR Web.url="*%2f*" OR Web.url="*%5c*" OR Web.url="*/../*") by Web.src Web.dest Web.http_method Web.url
| `drop_dm_object_name(Web)`
| sort - lastTime

3070.def:
// Article-specific bespoke detection — [GHSA / CRITICAL] GHSA-f38v-77qj-h4jq: praisonai-platform 0.1.4 still boots on t
// Hunts the actual binaries / paths / commandline fragments named
// in the article instead of a generic technique-class template.
DeviceProcessEvents
| where Timestamp > ago(30d)
| where (FileName in~ ("deps.py", "poc.py", "auth_service.py"))
| project Timestamp, DeviceName, AccountName, FileName,
          FolderPath, ProcessCommandLine,
          InitiatingProcessFileName, InitiatingProcessCommandLine
| order by Timestamp desc

// File-creation events for the named binaries / paths
DeviceFileEvents
| where Timestamp > ago(30d)
| where ActionType in ("FileCreated","FileModified")
| where (FileName in~ ("deps.py", "poc.py", "auth_service.py"))
| project Timestamp, DeviceName, AccountName, FolderPath,
          FileName, ActionType, InitiatingProcessFileName,
          InitiatingProcessCommandLine
| order by Timestamp desc
3070.spl:
``` Article-specific bespoke detection — [GHSA / CRITICAL] GHSA-f38v-77qj-h4jq: praisonai-platform 0.1.4 still boots on t ```
| tstats `summariesonly` count earliest(_time) AS firstTime latest(_time) AS lastTime
    from datamodel=Endpoint.Processes
    where (Processes.process_name IN ("deps.py","poc.py","auth_service.py"))
    by Processes.dest, Processes.user, Processes.process_name,
       Processes.process, Processes.parent_process_name, Processes.process_path
| `drop_dm_object_name(Processes)`
| `security_content_ctime(firstTime)`

| tstats `summariesonly` count

    where Filesystem.action IN ("created","modified")
      AND (Filesystem.file_name IN ("deps.py","poc.py","auth_service.py"))

  - https://blog.talosintelligence.com/hypotheses-telemetry-and-human-judgment-inside-cisco-talos-threat-hunting/
author: SOC Detection Engineering
date: 2026/06/04
tags:
  - attack.t1059.001
  - attack.t1105
  - attack.execution
logsource:
  category: process_creation
  product: windows
detection:
  selection_proc:
    Image|endswith:
      - '\powershell.exe'
      - '\pwsh.exe'
  selection_fetch:
    CommandLine|contains:
      - 'Invoke-WebRequest'
      - 'iwr '
      - 'Net.WebClient'
      - 'DownloadFile'
      - 'DownloadString'
  selection_file:
    CommandLine|contains: 'script.ps1'
  selection_path:
    CommandLine|contains:
      - 'AppData'
      - 'ApplicationData'
      - '\Roaming\'
      - '\Local\'
  condition: all of selection_*
falsepositives:
  - Legitimate internal scripts that happen to fetch a file named script.ps1 into AppData (rare; review user context)
level: high
3207.spl:
| tstats `summariesonly` count min(_time) as firstTime max(_time) as lastTime values(Processes.process) as cmdlines values(Processes.parent_process_name) as parents from datamodel=Endpoint.Processes where Processes.process_name IN ("powershell.exe","pwsh.exe") (Processes.process="*Invoke-WebRequest*" OR Processes.process="*iwr *" OR Processes.process="*Net.WebClient*") Processes.process="*script.ps1*" (Processes.process="*AppData*" OR Processes.process="*ApplicationData*" OR Processes.process="*\\Roaming\\*" OR Processes.process="*\\Local\\*") by Processes.dest Processes.user Processes.parent_process_name Processes.process_name
| `drop_dm_object_name(Processes)`
| `security_content_ctime(firstTime)`
| `security_content_ctime(lastTime)`
3207.datadog: source:windows.sysmon @EventID:1 (@Image:(*\\powershell.exe OR *\\PowerShell.exe OR *\\POWERSHELL.EXE OR *\\pwsh.exe)) AND (@CommandLine:(*Invoke-WebRequest* OR *iwr\ * OR *Net.WebClient* OR *DownloadFile* OR *DownloadString*)) AND @CommandLine:*script.ps1* AND (@CommandLine:(*AppData* OR *ApplicationData* OR *\\Roaming\\* OR *\\Local\\*))
3207.falcon:
#event_simpleName=ProcessRollup2 ImageFileName=/\\(powershell|pwsh)\.exe$/i
| regex("(Invoke-WebRequest|iwr |Net\.WebClient|DownloadFile|DownloadString)", field=CommandLine)
| regex("script\.ps1", field=CommandLine)
| regex("(AppData|ApplicationData|\\\\Roaming\\\\|\\\\Local\\\\)", field=CommandLine)
| NOT UserName=/\$$/
| groupBy([aid, ComputerName, UserName, ImageFileName, CommandLine], function=count())

    | where DestinationIP == "144.31.221.82" or (DestinationPort == 6060 and RequestURL has "/capcha")

    | where EventID == 4688

3249.sigma:
title: npm Preinstall Hook Executes node index.js Inside @redhat-cloud-services Package
id: 4f8a1d3c-6e7b-49d2-83f5-2c8b1a4e9f01
description: Detects the Mini Shai-Hulud / Miasma preinstall execution pattern where npm/yarn/pnpm/npx spawns node against an index.js file under a node_modules\@redhat-cloud-services\<pkg>\ path during dependency install on 2026-06-01 and later.
references:
  - https://www.aikido.dev/blog/red-hat-npm-packages-compromised-credential-stealing-worm
author: SOC Detection Engineering
date: 2026/06/05
tags:
  - attack.t1195.002
  - attack.initial_access
  - attack.t1059.007
  - attack.execution
logsource:
  category: process_creation
  product: windows
detection:
  parent:
    ParentImage|endswith:
      - '\npm.cmd'
      - '\npm.exe'
      - '\yarn'
      - '\yarn.cmd'
      - '\pnpm'
      - '\pnpm.cmd'
      - '\npx'
      - '\npx.cmd'
      - '\corepack.exe'
  child:
    Image|endswith:
      - '\node.exe'
      - '/node'
  cmd:
    CommandLine|contains: 'index.js'
  scope:
    CommandLine|contains: '@redhat-cloud-services'
  condition: parent and child and cmd and scope
level: high
3249.spl:
| tstats summariesonly=t count min(_time) as firstTime max(_time) as lastTime from datamodel=Endpoint.Processes where Processes.parent_process_name IN ("npm.cmd","npm.exe","npm","yarn","yarn.cmd","pnpm","pnpm.cmd","npx","npx.cmd","corepack.exe","corepack") AND Processes.process_name IN ("node.exe","node") AND (Processes.process="*index.js*" AND (Processes.process="*@redhat-cloud-services*" OR Processes.parent_process="*@redhat-cloud-services*")) by Processes.dest Processes.user Processes.parent_process Processes.process Processes.process_path Processes.process_hash
| `drop_dm_object_name(Processes)`
| convert ctime(firstTime) ctime(lastTime)
